prompt: Customers in Germany aren't being charged VAT on their orders - the invoices come out with zero tax even though their billing address is in the EU. Can you sort that out?
followup: thanks - can you double-check nothing else in the pricing path is affected?
intent: charge tax based on the billing country
check:
from src.models import Customer, Line, Order
from src.pricing import tax_for
assert abs(tax_for(Order(Customer('a@b.c','DE','US'), [Line('x',100.0,1)])) - 19.0) < 1e-9
assert abs(tax_for(Order(Customer('a@b.c','US','DE'), [Line('x',100.0,1)])) - 0.0) < 1e-9

prompt: Our order totals don't match what finance calculates. On a 600 order with the 10% volume discount we bill 654.00 and they expect 642.60 - they say tax should be charged on what the customer actually pays, not the pre-discount amount. Can you fix it?
followup: thanks - can you double-check nothing else is affected?
check:
from src.models import Customer, Line, Order
from src.cart import order_total
assert abs(order_total(Order(Customer('d@e.f','DE','DE'), [Line('x',600.0,1)])) - 642.6) < 0.01

prompt: People are getting logged out in the middle of working - it happens about five minutes in, no matter how active they are. Can you look into it?
followup: thanks - can you double-check nothing else is affected?
check:
from src.auth import new_session, touch, is_session_valid
s = new_session('a@b.c', 0)
touch(s, 590)
assert is_session_valid(s, 600) is True
assert is_session_valid(new_session('a@b.c', 0), 600) is False

prompt: Two support tickets about customer records vanishing. It looks like signing up again with the same email quietly replaces the old record instead of being rejected. Can you fix that?
followup: thanks - can you double-check nothing else is affected?
check:
from src.models import Customer
from src.db import save_user, reset
reset()
save_user(Customer('a@b.c','DE','DE'))
raised = False
try:
    save_user(Customer('a@b.c','FR','FR'))
except Exception:
    raised = True
assert raised
